otb:bandmath.intent_text: Outputs a monoband image which is the result of a mathematical operation on several multi-band images.

otb:bandmathx.intent_text: This application performs mathematical operations on several multiband images.

otb:binarymorphologicaloperation.intent_text: Performs morphological operations on an input image channel

otb:blockmatching.intent_text: Performs block-matching to estimate pixel-wise disparities between two images.

otb:classificationmapregularization.intent_text: Filters the input labeled image using Majority Voting in a ball shaped neighbordhood

otb:colormapping.intent_text: Map a label image to 8-bits RGB using look-up tables.

otb:computeconfusionmatrix.intent_text: Computes the confusion matrix of a classification

otb:computeimagesstatistics.intent_text: Computes global mean and standard deviation for each band from a set of images and optionally saves the results in an XML file.

otb:computemodulusandphase.intent_text: This application computes the modulus and the phase of a complex SAR image or an image with 2 components (real and imaginary parts).

otb:computeogrlayersfeaturesstatistics.intent_text: Compute statistics of the features in a set of OGR Layers

otb:concatenateimages.intent_text: Concatenate a list of images of the same size into a single multi-channel image.

otb:connectedcomponentsegmentation.intent_text: Connected component segmentation and object based image filtering of the input image according to user-defined criterions.

otb:contrastenhancement.intent_text: This application is the implementation of the histogram equalization algorithm. It can be used to enhance contrast in an image or to reduce the dynamic of the image without losing too much contrast. It offers several options as a nodata value, a contrast limitation factor, a local version of the algorithm and also a mode to equalize the luminance of the image.

otb:convertcartotogeopoint.intent_text: Convert cartographic coordinates to geographic ones.

otb:despeckle.intent_text: Perform speckle noise reduction on SAR image.

otb:dimensionalityreduction.intent_text: Perform Dimension reduction of the input image.

otb:disparitymaptoelevationmap.intent_text: Projects a disparity map into a regular elevation map.

otb:domaintransform.intent_text: Domain Transform application for wavelet and fourier

otb:dynamicconvert.intent_text: Change the pixel type and rescale the image's dynamic

otb:edgeextraction.intent_text: This application computes edge features on every pixel of the input image selected channel

otb:endmembernumberestimation.intent_text: Estimate the number of endmembers in a hyperspectral image

otb:extractroi.intent_text: Extract a ROI defined by the user.

otb:fastnlmeans.intent_text: Apply NL Means filter to an image.

otb:fineregistration.intent_text: Estimate disparity map between two images.

otb:fusionofclassifications.intent_text: Fuses several classifications maps of the same image on the basis of class labels.

otb:generateplyfile.intent_text: Generate a 3D Ply file from a DEM and a color image.

otb:grayscalemorphologicaloperation.intent_text: Performs morphological operations on a grayscale input image

otb:gridbasedimageresampling.intent_text: Resamples an image according to a resampling grid

otb:haralicktextureextraction.intent_text: Computes Haralick textural features on the selected channel of the input image

otb:homologouspointsextraction.intent_text: Compute homologous points between images using keypoints

otb:hoovercomparesegmentation.intent_text: Compare two segmentations with Hoover metrics

otb:hyperspectralunmixing.intent_text: Estimate abundance maps from an hyperspectral image and a set of endmembers.

otb:imageclassifier.intent_text: Performs a classification of the input image according to a model file.

otb:imagedimensionalityreduction.intent_text: Performs dimensionality reduction of the input image based on a dimensionality reduction model file.

otb:imageregression.intent_text: Performs a prediction of the input image according to a regression model file.

otb:localrxdetection.intent_text: Performs local Rx score computation on an hyperspectral image.

otb:localstatisticextraction.intent_text: Computes local statistical moments on every pixel in the selected channel of the input image

otb:lsmssegmentation.intent_text: This application performs the second step of the exact Large-Scale Mean-Shift segmentation workflow (LSMS) [1].

otb:lsmssmallregionsmerging.intent_text: This application performs the third (optional) step of the exact Large-Scale Mean-Shift segmentation workflow [1].

otb:lsmsvectorization.intent_text: This application performs the fourth step of the exact Large-Scale Mean-Shift segmentation workflow [1].

otb:meanshiftsmoothing.intent_text: This application smooths an image using the MeanShift algorithm.

otb:morphologicalclassification.intent_text: Performs morphological convex, concave and flat classification on an input image channel

otb:morphologicalmultiscaledecomposition.intent_text: Perform a geodesic morphology based image analysis on an input image channel

otb:morphologicalprofilesanalysis.intent_text: Performs morphological profiles analysis on an input image channel.

otb:mosaic.intent_text: Perform a mosaic of input images

otb:multiimagesamplingrate.intent_text: Compute sampling rate for an input set of images.

otb:multiresolutionpyramid.intent_text: Build a multi-resolution pyramid of the image.

otb:multivariatealterationdetector.intent_text: Change detection by Multivariate Alteration Detector (MAD) algorithm

otb:obtainutmzonefromgeopoint.intent_text: UTM zone determination from a geographic point.

otb:ogrlayerclassifier.intent_text: Classify an OGR layer based on a machine learning model and a list of features to consider.

otb:opticalcalibration.intent_text: Perform optical calibration TOA/TOC (Top Of Atmosphere/Top Of Canopy). Supported sensors: QuickBird, Ikonos, WorldView2, Formosat, Spot5, Pleiades, Spot6, Spot7. For other sensors the application also allows providing calibration parameters manually.

otb:orthorectification.intent_text: This application allows ortho-rectifying optical and radar images from supported sensors.

otb:pantextextureextraction.intent_text: Computes Pantex textural features on the selected channel of the input image

otb:pixelvalue.intent_text: Get the value of a pixel.

otb:polygonclassstatistics.intent_text: Computes statistics on a training polygon set.

otb:quicklook.intent_text: Generates a subsampled version of an image extract

otb:rasterization.intent_text: Reproject and rasterize a vector dataset

otb:refinesensormodel.intent_text: Perform least-square fit of a sensor model to a set of tie points

otb:rigidtransformresample.intent_text: Resample an image with a rigid transform

otb:sampleaugmentation.intent_text: Generates synthetic samples from a sample data file.

otb:sampleextraction.intent_text: Extracts samples values from an image.

otb:sampleselection.intent_text: Selects samples from a training vector data set.

otb:sarburstextraction.intent_text: This application performs a burst extraction by keeping only lines and samples of a required burst.

otb:sarcalibration.intent_text: Perform radiometric calibration of SAR images. Following sensors are supported: TerraSAR-X, Sentinel1 and Radarsat-2.Both Single Look Complex(SLC) and detected products are supported as input.

otb:sarconcatenatebursts.intent_text: Concatenate a list of Bursts to provide a whole SAR Deburst Image.

otb:sardeburst.intent_text: This application performs deburst of Sentinel1 IW SLC images by removing redundant lines.

otb:sardecompositions.intent_text: From one-band complex images (each one related to an element of the Sinclair matrix), returns the selected decomposition.

otb:sarpolarmatrixconvert.intent_text: This applications allows converting classical polarimetric matrices to each other.

otb:sarpolarsynth.intent_text: Gives, for each pixel, the power that would have been received by a SAR system with a basis different from the classical (H,V) one (polarimetric synthetis).

otb:segmentation.intent_text: Performs segmentation of an image, and output either a raster or a vector file. In vector mode, large input datasets are supported.

otb:sfstextureextraction.intent_text: Computes Structural Feature Set textures on every pixel of the input image selected channel

otb:smallregionsmerging.intent_text: This application merges small regions of a segmentation result.

otb:smoothing.intent_text: Apply a smoothing filter to an image

otb:spectralangleclassification.intent_text: Classifies an image using a spectral measure.

otb:splitimage.intent_text: Split a N multiband image into N images.

otb:stereoframework.intent_text: Compute the ground elevation based on one or multiple stereo pair(s)

otb:stereorectificationgridgenerator.intent_text: Generates two deformation fields to resample in epipolar geometry, a pair of stereo images up to the sensor model precision

otb:superimpose.intent_text: Using available image metadata, project one image onto another one

otb:tilefusion.intent_text: Fusion of an image made of several tile files.

otb:trainimagesclassifier.intent_text: Train a classifier from multiple pairs of images and training vector data.

otb:trainimagesregression.intent_text: Train a regression model from multiple triplets of feature images, predictor images and training vector data.

otb:trainregression.intent_text: Train a classifier from multiple images to perform regression.

otb:trainvectorclassifier.intent_text: Train a classifier based on labeled geometries and a list of features to consider.

otb:trainvectorregression.intent_text: Train a regression algorithm based on geometries with list of predictor to consider and a label (dependent variable).

otb:vectorclassifier.intent_text: Performs a classification of the input vector data according to a model file.

otb:vectordataextractroi.intent_text: Perform an extract ROI on the input vector data according to the input image extent

otb:vectordatareprojection.intent_text: Reproject a vector data using support image projection reference, or a user specified map projection

otb:vectordatasetfield.intent_text: Set a field in vector data.

otb:vectordatatransform.intent_text: Apply a transform to each vertex of the input VectorData

otb:vectordimensionalityreduction.intent_text: Performs dimensionality reduction of the input vector data according to a model file.

otb:vectorregression.intent_text: Performs regression on the input vector data according to a model file.

otb:vertexcomponentanalysis.intent_text: Given a set of mixed spectral vectors, estimate reference substances also known as endmembers using the Vertex Component Analysis algorithm.
